settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Standard orders ship within 1-2 business days and typically arrive within 3-7 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: Unopened products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. See our Refund Policy page for full details.

settings.heading: Are your products dermatologist tested?
settings.row_content: Yes. Every formula is developed with dermatologist input and evaluated for tolerability before release.

settings.heading: Do you test on animals?
settings.row_content: No. C-Aesthetics products and ingredients are never tested on animals.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right routine for my skin?
settings.row_content: Each product page lists the skin concerns it targets. If you're not sure where to start, reach out through our Contact page and our team can help.
